title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling samples, quickstarts and docs site update
author: Liam Chen
ci_details: ci/lint: failed on first run (style/markdown) then fixed and passed
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates, new tool-calling example apps and a docs quickstart. No breaking changes. Backward-compatible examples for both SDKs and docs site.
description:
Summary: Adds a set of RAG agent templates, tool-calling example apps (Python + TS), and corresponding quickstart pages on the docs site. This PR bundles small runtime-safe example code, updated docs navigation, and a few helper utilities used by the examples. Motivation: make it straightforward for developers to get started with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) + tool-calling patterns using Redwood examples and docs. Checklist:
- [x] RAG agent template files for redwood-examples
- [x] Tool-calling sample app (Python) that demonstrates function/tool registration + structured outputs
- [x] TypeScript example app for frontend integration + streaming support
- [x] Docs quickstart pages with screenshots and code snippets
- [x] Add nav to docs site and meta tags for SEO
- [x] CI checks and example smoke tests

What changed (high level):
- Added /redwood-examples/rag-agent-templates/{faq-bot,ops-runbook,customer-support} with parameterized manifests and README quickstarts.
- Added /redwood-examples/tool-calling/{python-sample,ts-sample} showing how to register tools, call external APIs, and surface structured JSON results.
- Docs site: updated docs/content/quickstarts/rag-agent.md and added quickstarts/tool-calling.md with code snippets and troubleshooting notes. Added nav entries in docs/config/navigation.yml.
- Small helper: examples/common/tool_wrappers.py and examples/common/ts_helpers.ts for consistent tool interfaces and test harnesses.

Testing and QA:
- Unit tests added for examples harness (examples/test/test_tool_wrappers.py).
- Integration smoke tests run in CI using the new examples (CI uses a lightweight mock HTTP server for external tools).
- Verified pipes/streaming on TS sample with local dev server.

Backward compatibility and rollout:
- Examples are opt-in and do not change runtime behavior. No schema or API changes to Redwood runtime. Documentation-only changes for the docs site were gated behind a docs build flag.

Notes for reviewers:
- The initial lint run failed due to markdown formatting in one of the READMEs; fixed in follow-up commit.
- Kept example manifests minimal to reduce maintenance overhead; added thorough README usage notes instead of large example datasets.

Related: ENG-4823 for RAG workstream; SUP-1104 customer ask to provide agent templates for support flows.
